No per-line net amount is printed, so net_amount is null. The tax-table TOTAL AMT of 2889.58 is stored in tax_summary.
The summary label 'HASH' (value 10) is read as the total quantity because it equals the line quantity. The STR column value 'AC' is stored as str_code.
